title: Mosh Pit!
description: Adds a throwable item for bouncy and safe landings.
body:
# Mosh Pit!

**Mosh Pit!** adds a new movement mechanic and resources to your survival world!
It allows you to create a temporary platform for safe and dynamic landings when jumping from heights. It is a very small-scale mod.
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/G-vWLOkO2bk" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Features
* **Tree Jelly:** Occasionally drops when stripping logs with an axe.
* **Mosh Ball:** Craftable with Sand and Jelly. When thrown, it deploys a "Mosh Pit" at the point of impact.
* **Mosh Pit:** A 3x3 platform generated upon impact. It naturally disappears after 7 seconds. It reliably creates a footing anywhere, including slopes, water, and lava.

![Mosh Pit](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b07cb973b70660f9be55c80200687857a711dc08_0.webp)

## Supported Languages
**Mosh Pit!** is currently available in the following 9 languages:

* 🇺🇸 **English** (US)
* 🇯🇵 **Japanese** (日本語)
* 🇨🇳 **Chinese Simplified** (简体中文)
* 🇹🇼 **Chinese Traditional** (繁體中文)
* 🇪🇸 **Spanish** (Español)
* 🇫🇷 **French** (Français)
* 🇩🇪 **German** (Deutsch)
* 🇷🇺 **Russian** (Русский)
* 🇰🇷 **Korean** (한국어)
